### Cumulative narrative

- **API profile (`atoms_vs_ashes`):** structured connector fills in domain tables; use per-criterion averages above to see where REST/GIS enrichment landed.
- **LLM profile (`atoms_vs_ashes_llm`):** same schema plus `screening_verdicts` (verdict, confidence, justification) per site/SMR/criterion when assessments ran.
- **Combined interpretability:** high field fill supports deterministic screening; verdicts document reasoning where data are thin or ambiguous.
